messages.subject: Juniper mobilisation - WMS integration & opening stock
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Mobilisation underway. Couple of legal points from the ops side: (1) Wexbourne want to start trickling opening stock in from 18 June - are we covered for storage liability before go-live on 1 July? (2) the API integration build is on track. Can you confirm the bailment/liability provisions bite from receipt of goods, not from go-live?

Mark Tennant
Operations, Sutherland Logistics

messages.subject: RE: Juniper mobilisation - WMS integration & opening stock
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark,

Yes - under clause 3.4 we hold the goods as bailee and liability for loss/damage runs from when goods come into our custody (clause 11.1), which covers the pre-go-live opening stock from 18 June. Just make sure the goods-in-trust insurer is on notice of stock on site from that date. I'll drop the broker a line to confirm.

Elena
